description:
Change one thing about an icon that is almost right, keeping everything else as it is. Needs a paid Claycut key and costs one icon. Returns a download URL for the edited transparent PNG.

Use it instead of generate_app_icon when the user likes an icon but wants a detail fixed: a new generation redraws the whole object and loses what they liked. Pass the icon's URL (a Claycut asset URL, or any public PNG) and a short instruction. Up to three changes per call; describe the end state to draw ("the grey plate behind the star becomes clear violet crystal"), not what to remove. Name what must not change if it's at risk. Always edit the original, not a previous edit, and add the result to the '## Icons' list in CLAYCUT.md.

image_url.description: Public URL of the PNG to edit

instruction.description: What to change, as the end state to draw

name: edit_app_icon
